import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch.  Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# ChangeSpec name -> branch name conversion.
is_changespec = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_changespec:
        # ChangeSpec ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_prompt_list_markers.py`** (new) — the shared, family-parameterized layer:
- `MarkerFamily` (`HYPHEN` / `ORDERED`) and `ListMarker` (row, indent, family, content column, number, digits, delimiter, `.text`)
- `find_list_marker`, `is_list_boundary_line`, `list_marker_owner`, `owned_block_end`, all pure and bounded by `MAX_SCANNED_LINES`. Each family treats the other's markers as hard boundaries.

**`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_prompt_ordered_editing.py`** (new) — the ordered engine:
- Ordered mirrors of the hyphen predicates (`is_prompt_ordered_marker_only`, `is_prompt_ordered_content_column`, `prompt_ordered_row_has_item_above`, `strip_prompt_ordered_marker`)
- `find_ordered_run` — same indent + same delimiter, transparent blank lines, owned continuations, nested runs skipped, prose/delimiter change terminating
- `OrderedRun.repeat_style` / `number_at`, `prompt_ordered_sibling_prefix` (inserted-number rule), `renumber_ordered_runs` (owned-block width shifting + cursor column shifts)
- `plan_ordered_list_edit` — the single-edit planner: apply-copy → renumber anchors → minimal contiguous row diff → one `TextEdit` with the cursor computed from the rebuilt text. Runs over 400 items or 2000 scanned lines silently skip renumbering and still perform the structural edit.

**`_prompt_bullet_editing.py`** refactored onto the shared primitives, behavior-preserving.

## One design correction worth flagging

The plan states repeat style as "the second item's number equals the first's." Prettier's actual rule is that the **second item is numbered `1`** (its "git diff friendly" list), after which item 0 keeps its own number and every later item stays `1` — so `9. / 1. / 1.` is preserved rather than becoming `9. / 10. / 11.`. Since design principle 2 makes formatter agreement the governing rule, I implemented Prettier's real behavior and pinned it with tests that shell out to the actual `prettier` binary in both directions. This is recorded as a note on the bead for phases .2–.5.
